beats.copy: Your next deal is in here somewhere
beats.carrier_state: none yet: the soft coral/teal gradient is the atmosphere
beats.note: words build in at different baselines, 'here' in the accent colour

beats.carrier_state: the word 'here' grows huge, blurred, and splits to admit a vertical app stack (mail, chat, WhatsApp, Instagram)
beats.note: giant type, an object inside it: the mask-and-split signature

beats.carrier_state: the stack tilts into a white pill on a halftone dot field; a red redaction bar crosses a letter

beats.copy: You are a really busy person
beats.carrier_state: a coral orb (the carrier) enters as a dot beside 'busy person'
beats.note: ground flips dark; the orb is first seen here

beats.carrier_state: the highlight chip stretches into a full-width bar
the bar's corner draws a bracket that becomes the logo mark
'One inbox' pushes in big, then slides under the next line; an inbox window frames in
beats.note: capability 1: line first, then the simple UI proof

beats.copy: It learns that matters to you
beats.carrier_state: the orb returns as a small dot leading each word; inbox list stays beside
beats.note: capability 2: words build with an accent dot, one word swaps

beats.carrier_state: the orb sits left of the line while the inbox list reorders
beats.note: words swap in place; the UI proves the line

beats.carrier_state: the orb becomes a cursor inside a phone mockup; WhatsApp in its own green
beats.note: one small line beside an almost-empty phone; a break in the music just before

beats.carrier_state: the orb grows into a full-frame sphere
beats.note: no copy: the carrier is the whole picture

beats.carrier_state: the sphere settles behind a notification card
beats.note: payoff of capability 2; small greyed wordmark (logo 2)

beats.copy: It drafts replies that sound like you
beats.carrier_state: a prompt box (the card) types the line and grows into a draft message
beats.note: capability 3: ground flips dark on a flash; the box is the carrier

beats.carrier_state: a count-up in the middle of the frame
beats.note: social proof as a number that rises

beats.carrier_state: the line grows huge and an iris wipe closes it
beats.note: the last line, then a pinwheel mask to the end card

beats.carrier_state: a blurred orb resolves into the mark; the url types in; holds
beats.note: end card (logo 3), small, holds about 5 s

note: timings are read from a 1 fps contact sheet and the word timings: good to about 0.5 s. This is the shape of the score the Motion Director writes for a launch film (references/score.md, references/launch-grammar.md).
